## Adversarial review
<!-- Answer all five. If you cannot answer one, say so instead of deleting it. -->
1. Why is this needed — what concrete defect or failure does it prevent?
2. What breaks if this is not merged?
3. What is the simpler alternative, and why was it rejected?
4. What does this cost (runtime, maintenance, review burden)?
5. What would falsify this change — when should it be deleted?
